profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Afinidata || Full stack developer
profile.summary: Full stack Engineer with complementary experiences in developing ARM based embedded systems for next generation retail experiences, now seeking the next opportunity.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Collaborated with and led a team of developers through strategic task allocation and performance evaluations to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions within demanding timelines.
● Architected and sustained numerous microservices, providing a deep understanding of technical architecture required for issue resolution and system support.
● Managed the end-to-end deployment and maintenance of a Kubernetes cluster with over 15 microservices using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with Terraform.
● Administered and optimized AWS infrastructure, managing multiple EC2 instances, RDS databases, and DNS configurations via Route 53 to ensure high availability, scalability, and security.
● Implemented Terraform modules to automate the provisioning of AWS resources and streamline infrastructure management across development and production environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built microcontroller (ARM64 based) Python testing tools and framework
Developed a web based observability system to surface microcontroller and software component health
Authored both interface code and key functionalities for ARM64 based microcontrollers

positions.title: Junior Front End Developer
positions.description:
Improved the existing software development framework to enable a more mature and easier-to-use SDLC processes  for front-end development which aligns with industry best practices for Scrum.
Maintained and developed the data analysis website.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
● Improved the software development framework to institute more mature and user-friendly SDLC processes, aligning with Scrum best practices to increase efficiency.
● Maintained and developed a data analysis dashboard for enterprise customers, navigating and organizing data to meet client needs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Continuously engaged with upper management to review the progress, and to receive feedback to incorporate it into the work stream.

positions.description:
